# M&M Websites

> M&M Websites designs, builds, hosts and maintains websites for local service businesses (detailers, trades, salons, restaurants and similar). It is a fully managed service: $600 one time to build the site, then $45 a month to keep it online and up to date.

## What M&M Websites does

- Custom, mobile-first websites written by hand (HTML, CSS and JavaScript), not a template or page builder theme.
- Booking and quote request forms that send requests to the business's inbox, with a live price estimate where the pricing allows it.
- Search-ready pages: clean page structure, local search basics, structured data, a sitemap and fast load times.
- Launch help: registering the domain, hosting the site and helping set up the Google Business Profile.
- Ongoing updates on the monthly plan: new photos, changed prices, services, hours and seasonal specials.

## Pricing and payment

- Website setup: $600 one time.
- Website maintenance: $45 a month.
- Due at signup: $645 (setup plus the first month). After that, $45 is billed automatically each month.
- Payment is by card, Apple Pay or Link on Stripe's secure checkout. Stripe emails a receipt for every payment.
- Clients manage billing, cards and cancellation at https://billing.stripe.com/p/login/7sY28qcdi8Bg29nbfEaEE00

## How the service works

- M&M Websites provides the website, its code, the hosting and the domain as a service while the monthly plan is active. They belong to M&M Websites and cannot be transferred or handed to someone else.
- If the monthly plan is cancelled or payments stop, the site is taken offline, the domain is paused and updates stop.
- Clients keep the rights to their own business name, logo, photos and the words they supply.

## Work

- [Legendary Detailing case study](https://mnmwebsitesforyou.com/work/legendary-detailing/): a mobile-first site for a mobile auto detailer in Memphis, TN, with a two-step booking request form and a live price estimate.
